chapter_title: Concerning the Five Things that he constructed wit
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** The Lord's operative wisdom — the Divine proceeding as active spiritual power — established five essential structural orderings of the spiritual world out of the channels through which interior life flows and out of the outermost intellectual containments within the most resistant [GAP-1: dense and unyielding natural states of the external mind].

**¶2:** The first is the foundational ground of natural truth that rests upon the sustaining power of the Divine principle that upholds all things.

**¶3:** The second is the spanning connective truths of [GAP-2: the] fundamental supporting doctrine that stands in the presence of that sustaining power.

**¶4:** The third is the determining pattern that gives boundary and fixed form to the hells — the ordering structure imposed upon states of evil and falsity so that they cannot spread beyond their allotted limits.

**¶5:** The fourth is the [GAP-3: fullness of] supporting truths that the Lord has established within the vast general plane of natural knowledge, throughout [GAP-4: the] complete extent of all spiritual states in their ordered provinces.

**¶6:** The fifth is the fourfold enclosure of protecting truths that surrounds on every side the recipient forms of the mind — the containing structures through which good and truth are received and held.

---
*Note:* The overall passage describes how the Lord's active wisdom constructed the entire spiritual architecture — the ground that supports, the truths that connect, the boundaries that constrain hell, the doctrines that sustain throughout all states, and the protective enclosures around every vessel of reception.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Living Spirit constructed five great things from veins and skull[s in the] hard [bodies].
The first is the disc that is placed upon [the sh]oulder of the Porter.
The se[con]d are the arches of [the] pillar that is before him.
[The th]ird is the [mou]ld of the fo[r]m for the gehennas.
The fourth are the [seven] pillars that he has erected in the great sea, in [the] seven parts of the universe.
The fifth are the four walls that surround the vessels.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading's "dense and unyielding natural states of the external mind" corresponds precisely to the Manichaean image of the hard bodies of the defeated archons — the most resistant outermost natural containers from which the Living Spirit constructs cosmic structure.
The definite article "the" is grammatically required before "pillar" and is confirmed by the spiritual reading's reference to "the fundamental supporting doctrine."

The spiritual reading's "fullness of supporting truths" corresponds to "seven" since seven signifies fullness and completeness in correspondential logic, and the parallel with "seven parts of the universe" later in the same sentence confirms the internal coherence.
The definite article "the" is grammatically required before "seven parts" and is confirmed by the spiritual reading's "the complete extent of all spiritual states."
